title: Backorder Notice, Substitution, Billing and Auto-Cancel Rules
content:
**Ship-To Fulfillment Account — backorder rules.** The periods and options are the level's own, as set in the backorder terms table.

1. The customer is told of each backorder and its promise date within the level's backorder notice period in business days of booking.
2. When a backorder has no confirmed fill date the level's substitution offer period in calendar days after the backorder date, Corbett offers an approved substitute; an accepted substitute ships against the same backorder and, where the level bills a substitute at the lower price, is billed at the lower of its own price and the original item's price.
3. A backorder fill is billed under the level's backorder fill price basis at the price in effect on its ship date, and its freight follows the freight and fee rules.
4. The customer may cancel open backorder quantity of a stocked item at any time with no fee; open backorder quantity of a special-order item is cancelled under the order line cancellation rules.
5. An open backorder is cancelled automatically once the level's auto-cancel period in calendar days has passed since the backorder date.
6. Count calendar days starting the day after the backorder date; the backorder is cancelled on the day after the last day of the period, and a backorder the customer extended once by the level's extension period in days is cancelled on the day after the extended period instead.
7. Each backorder may be extended only once.

### The auto-cancel clock

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Event the clock starts from | the backorder date shown on the backorder record |
| Counting | calendar days, day 1 being the day after the backorder date |
| Last day of the period | the day numbered as the auto-cancel period |
| Day of cancellation | the day after the last day of the period (the period must have passed in full; the last day itself is not a cancellation day) |
| Backorder extended once | cancelled on the day after the extended period instead |

*Hypothetical boundary cases* (auto-cancel period written as N days): on day N after the backorder date the backorder is still open; it is cancelled on day N plus one. A backorder the customer has extended once is not cancelled on day N plus one but on the day after its extended period.

### Basis Q&A

**Does the customer pay a fee to cancel backordered stock?** No. Open backorder quantity of a stocked item may be cancelled at any time with no fee; a special-order item's open backorder quantity is cancelled under the cancellation rules for special-order lines.

**Can a backorder be extended a second time?** No. Each backorder may be extended only once.
